unsubscribe.label: Stop these emails
unsubscribe.line: No more of these? One click, no account needed: {unsubscribeUrl}

page.doneBody: We will not send you any more follow-up about the practitioner platform. Nothing else changes, and you do not need to do anything further.
page.alreadyBody: This address is already off the follow-up list, so this click changed nothing.
page.invalidBody: The link may have been cut short by a mail client. Nobody has been unsubscribed. Reply to any of our emails and we will take you off the list by hand.
page.footnote: Practitioner platform follow-up only. This has nothing to do with any client of yours.

eventLeadThanks.subject: Thank you for leaving your name
eventLeadThanks.preheader: Your referral code and the link to set up your practice.
eventLeadThanks.heading: {firstName}, thank you
paragraphs: You left your name with us today, so here is everything you need in one place.
Your referral code is {referralCode}. Anyone who arrives on it is recorded as having come from you.
When you are ready, you can set up your practice yourself — it takes a few minutes and you choose your own address and password.

eventLeadWhatItDoes.subject: What the platform actually does
eventLeadWhatItDoes.heading: {firstName}, what this actually is
paragraphs: A short and honest answer, since a room is a hard place to explain software.
Your practice gets its own portal: a place your clients sign in, intake you send and read, scheduling, your session notes, and agreements they can sign. It is one place instead of five.
Founding partners are set up as a comped practice. If it is not useful to you, say so and we will stop writing.

eventLeadLastNote.subject: A last note
eventLeadLastNote.preheader: The link stays open; this is the last time we write.
eventLeadLastNote.heading: {firstName}, a last note
paragraphs: This is the last of these you will get from us — a professional's inbox is not a place to keep knocking.
The link below stays open whenever the timing is better. Nothing expires.
If you would rather we set it up with you instead of you doing it alone, reply to this email and we will find a time.

foundingWelcome.subject: Your practice is set up
foundingWelcome.preheader: Your portal address and the first three things to do.
foundingWelcome.heading: {firstName}, your practice is ready
paragraphs: Your portal is at {portalUrl}. Sign in with the email and password you chose.
Three things worth doing first: put your practice name and hours in settings, send an intake to one client you know well, and read what comes back.
You are a founding partner, which means your questions shape what gets built next. Reply to this email with anything that is missing.

foundingCheckIn.subject: How is the first week going?
foundingCheckIn.heading: {firstName}, how is it going?
paragraphs: It has been a week since your practice was set up, so this is a genuine question rather than a nudge: what has been awkward?
If you have not had a chance to open it yet, that is fine too — nothing was lost and your portal is still at {portalUrl}.
One sentence back is plenty. A founding partner's complaint is more useful to us than a compliment.
